other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Drinking water treatment and distribution utility running continuously, with 24/7 pumping of water and process operations being the dominant energy use
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Submeter data showed more than 75% of all energy is 
consumed pumping water with electric motors (combined 
18,000 hp), so the most in-depth analysis is performed on 
these systems.

one_line: Case study of Des Moines Water Works, a municipal drinking water utility, implementing an ISO 50001 / SEP 50001 energy management system to cut energy intensity across its treatment plants and fleet.
